verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's homepage states you can "manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack," and the changelog confirms Slack-side actions such as starting post-incident reviews, so incident handling from chat is first-party but described only in one-line marketing terms. missing for 10: evidence of declaring an incident from Slack, automatic incident channel creation, role assignment in chat, automated status updates posted to the channel, any Microsoft Teams support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
